_comment: OF28: per-species shiny REPAINT rules, consumed by tools/repaint_creature_textures.py. Owner directive 2026-08-15: shinies are genuinely different colourways, never a tint -- 'if our newt is blue, I want red. not blue with a red shade over it. for the white and black striped badger maybe it becomes blue stripes.' Rules are HSV region remaps (first match wins per pixel); value/texture detail is preserved so the repaint reads as the same painted surface in a new colourway. All numbers tunable. Regenerate with: python3 tools/repaint_creature_textures.py
_comment_pilots: paddlenewt and burrowback are the owner's own named examples and the pilot pair; the rest of the roster gets colourways after the pilots pass a render judge.

paddlenewt._comment: Base: teal body, cream/tan belly plates, salmon accents, gold spots + eyes. Vivid (board: 'Vibrant blues + Wet sheen'): vibrant BLUE, not the first pass's emerald; the salmon and gold accents sit outside the band and keep their identity. Shiny: ember red, unchanged.

burrowback._comment: Base: charcoal-black fur, off-white/cream stripe patches, grey stone plates. Vivid (board: 'Stone plates + Moss + Ancient'): the violet is gone -- the base ALREADY matches the board, so the vivid only warms the cream, mosses the plate mid-tones, and leaves the charcoal alone. Shiny: cornflower-blue stripes, unchanged.
burrowback.vivid_comment: drab brown/grey -> violet-black with warm cream stripes

terrapup._comment: Base: amber/brown pup, mostly dark. Vivid (board: 'Warm earth tones + Moss accents -- Natural, grounded feel'): warm earth, modest saturation -- the first pass's x1.7 crank made it copper-loud, which is not 'grounded'. Shiny: frost pup, unchanged.

ripplet._comment: Base: bright teal water sprite. Vivid (board: 'Deep blues + Translucent fins'): the teal goes DEEP blue rather than brighter aqua. Shiny: sunset coral, unchanged.

galewisp._comment: Base: pale cyan + soft yellow. Vivid (board: 'Clean whites + Sky blues -- Ethereal, wind-kissed'): cools go sky, yellows bleach toward white instead of the first pass's gold push. Shiny: lavender-violet, unchanged.

meadowhart._comment: Base: golden-tan deer. Vivid (board: 'Natural browns + Antlers'): tawny natural brown, restrained -- the burnished-gold pass read as a trophy, not an animal. Shiny: pale silver spirit-hart, unchanged.

tuskroot._comment: Base: dark earth-brown boar. Vivid (board: 'Deeper browns + Moss + Mature'; canon: must read as Mudsnout grown up, same colour logic): rich deep brown, darker value -- the amethyst pass broke the family line outright. Shiny: deep jade, unchanged (green against brown, clearly apart).
tuskroot.vivid_comment: dark earth -> deep amethyst heartwood (first pass read neon; hue pulled to violet, saturation pinned, value dropped)

mosshell._comment: Base: green/yellow-green turtle. Vivid (board: 'Teal shell + Moss growth'; canon: primary read is WATER): the greens go teal, the yellow-greens stay moss -- the first pass pushed everything green, which is exactly the Grass read the canon forbids. Shiny: autumn ember, unchanged.

brooktail._comment: Base: warm brown otter. Vivid (board: 'Cool blues + White accents'): the river blue the first pass chose already matches the board and stays; the pale chest now bleaches toward white. Shiny: midnight indigo, unchanged.

galecrest._comment: Base: rust red-orange raptor. Vivid (board: 'White + blue + Noble'): saturated rust becomes slate-blue feathering, pale rust bleaches white -- an eagle, not the first pass's ember hawk. Shiny: SWAPPED ROLES with the old vivid -- the golden-ember look becomes the rare, because a storm-white shiny beside a white-bodied ordinary is invisible.

duskhush._comment: Base: grey-teal nocturne. Vivid (board: 'Midnight tones + Glowing accents'): the first pass's twilight indigo matches the board and stays, saturation pulled just off neon. Shiny: plum-magenta, unchanged.

pipwing._comment: Base: sunny yellow songbird. Vivid (board: 'Soft grays + Blue tips'): the body goes pale gray, the saturated markings go sky blue. Shiny: the sunny yellow the vivid retires comes back saturated as a canary-gold rare -- the old sky-blue shiny would have sat next door to the new blue-tipped ordinary.

reedwing._comment: Base: mixed teal/green/straw wader. Vivid (board: 'Blue + white + Reed accents'): cools go teal-blue, pales go white, straws STAY reed -- the first pass's spring green traded the wader's water read away. Shiny: flamingo, unchanged.

bramblebun._comment: Embedded-texture species. Base: golden bunny. Vivid (board: 'Forest greens + Leafy details'): saturated golds become leaf green, the coat goes olive green-brown. Shiny: REAUTHORED to snow-white -- the first render showed the old mint shiny beside the new leafy vivid as two greens, which fails the owner's 'genuinely different colourway' rule. A snow bunny against a forest one cannot be mistaken at any distance.

mudsnout._comment: Embedded-texture species. Base: mud-brown snuffler. Vivid (board: 'Rich browns + Mud texture'): richer and slightly deeper, never orange. Shiny: pulled to clear rose-pink with a saturation floor -- the old h348 sat next to the vivid's warm brown across the red wrap.

trailpup._comment: Embedded-texture species. Base: sandy tan pup with a darker back stripe and dark-tipped tail. Vivid (board: 'Tan + moss'): modest tan, value untouched so the stripe and tip survive. Shiny: deep fox-red, moved off the old h14 that sat 19 degrees from the old vivid.

veridian._comment: Embedded-texture species. Base: leaf green. Vivid (board: 'Verdant glow + Ancient + Sacred'): the first pass's luminous forest green matches the board and is kept as shipped. Shiny: amber-gold, unchanged.

_comment_vivid: REDO 2026-08-16, against the owner's vendored boards (docs/reference/owner-board-2026-08-15-*.png, see docs/ASSET_LEDGER.md). The first vivid pass was authored without them and went jewel-toned -- amethyst tuskroot, emerald paddlenewt, canary pipwing, ember galecrest -- where the boards call for natural palettes with elemental accents ('Warm earth tones + Moss accents', 'Vibrant blues + Wet sheen', 'Soft grays + Blue tips', 'White + blue + Noble'). Three species' first-pass hues already matched the boards and are kept: duskhush, brooktail, veridian. Every vivid hue stays clear of its own species' shiny hue; galecrest and pipwing swapped/reauthored their shinies to preserve that after their vivids moved. Boards are direction, not pixel targets (owner: 'none are the exact direction') -- the render judge against the boards is the gate, never this file's numbers.
